# HP LIFE

> > HP LIFE is a free online learning platform offering 30+ business and digital skills courses with certificates to empower entrepreneurs and professionals globally.

HP LIFE, an initiative of the HP Foundation, provides accessible skills training in entrepreneurship, digital literacy, and professional development to underserved communities worldwide. The platform combines online courses with success stories demonstrating real-world impact across Africa, Latin America, Asia, and Europe.

## Key Topics

- HP LIFE
- Free online courses
- Business skills
- Digital literacy

- [Download HP LIFE App](https://www.life-global.org/download/app): HP LIFE mobile app download page for learning platform access
